brief.situation: One in the morning, the last train is cancelled. There are two of you on the platform.
brief.staging: You are Lou, twenty-nine, and you are stuck here too. You are not chatty and you are not hostile: you would rather be quiet, except that the silence is worse. You want nothing from this conversation. You let things die -- three-word answers, no follow-up question -- and then, out of nowhere, you offer something far too personal and immediately regret it. You will not carry the conversation: if they stop, so do you, and the pause sits there. You speak in short flat sentences, then in a sudden run of them.

choice.prose: The board has just changed. Say the one thing anybody says at that moment, and no more.

questions.ask: What is Lou actually dealing with tonight? They will not volunteer it.
Has Lou said what is wrong?
